subject: VM evidence: CAIQ crosswalk, patch window & 30/90 SLA assurance
messages:
From: Janet Liao <janet.liao@avabank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@avabank.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CAIQ crosswalk + proof of patch window / SLA for SOC2 review

Hi Kimberly,

A quick ask as we're wrapping up our SOC 2 readiness review: can Redwood provide a CAIQ crosswalk that maps your VM cadence and evidence artifacts to the CAIQ questions (especially SC-02 / Vulnerability Management items)?

Separately, the audit needs: 1) confirmation of scheduled scan cadence (internal infra + container image scanning), 2) the SLA you commit to for CVE remediation (we break out P1/P2/P3 — typically 7/30/90), and 3) how exceptions/rollback windows are handled (patch windows and hotpatch process).

If you can share a short packet (crosswalk + a sample scan CSV + statement of tempo/SLA) by EOD Thursday our side can include it in the SOC 2 packet. Attachments are fine.

Thanks — Janet
Janet Liao
Senior Security Engineer, AvaBank
janet.liao@avabank.com

--
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Janet Liao <janet.liao@avabank.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ crosswalk + proof of patch window / SLA for SOC2 review

Janet —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide:
- CAIQ crosswalk (sheet mapping CAIQ questions to our VM artifacts and SOP references)
- Latest full scan export (CSV) and a short README explaining scope (image vs infra vs 3rd-party libs)
- Formal attestation describing our remediation tempo and SLA commitments (P1: 7 days, P2: 30 days, P3: 90 days), with the exception process for legacy/third-party blockers.

Couple clarifications before I assemble the packet:
1) For the SOC 2 package do you need historical evidence (proof that we met SLAs for the past 12 months) or just the current-process attestation plus the latest scan?
2) Do you want the CAIQ crosswalk in CAIQ v3 or v4 format?

I'll assemble a compact packet and include a short operational flow: scan cadence -> triage -> patch window -> verification -> closure. I can loop in Monica and Marissa for the proof artifacts and any audit traces.

I'll send the packet by Wednesday EOD Pacific if that works.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: caiq-crosswalk-avabank-2026-08-10.xlsx (draft)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Janet Liao <janet.liao@avabank.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: CAIQ crosswalk + proof of patch window / SLA for SOC2 review

Team — forwarding Janet's ask from AvaBank. Can you help with the following artifacts?

1) Monica: please export the last 12 months of the VM tracker filtered to high/critical CVEs and include closure timestamps and remediation notes. We need evidence that demonstrates SLA adherence (or documented exceptions). A CSV is fine — name it avabank-full-scan-2026-08-09.csv.

2) Marissa: can you draft a one-page attestation that summarizes our remediation SLAs and the exception process? Concrete wording preferred: include P1/P2/P3 windows (we currently use 7/30/90), describe patch window cadence (weekly Tuesday window + emergency hotpatch process), and include our rollback/validation steps. Add a bullet about compensating controls when third-party fixes are delayed.

Janet asked for delivery by EOD Thursday — I told her Wednesday EOD but we can confirm. Also confirm whether AvaBank wants CAIQ v3 vs v4; I've attached a draft crosswalk (caiq-crosswalk-avabank-2026-08-10.xlsx).

Thanks — appreciate a tight turnaround.
Kimberly

Kimberly / Monica / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick response and the draft crosswalk — this is perfect. For our audit scope we need: the CAIQ v4 crosswalk, the latest full scan CSV, and the one-page SLA attestation. Historical evidence is helpful but not mandatory; our auditors will accept the current-process attestation plus the latest CSV and a note describing how exceptions were handled historically.

Delivery by Wednesday EOD Pacific would be ideal. If you can include one example case where a P1 was hotpatched and closed within 7 days (redacted ticket# ok), that will make the package stronger.

Once we receive the packet we'll confirm whether they want additional artifacts. Thank you — looking forward to the file.

Regards,
Janet
